sections.title: Contributors to population change in South Lakeland
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component, %

sections.content:
We estimate that, for South Lakeland, between 2025 and 2028:

  • More deaths than births meant that the population decreased by 6,850 people (−6.5%). In total, there were 6,741 births and 13,591 deaths in South Lakeland between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in England) increased the population by 10,029 (9.6%). There were 60,361 people entering the area and 50,332 people leaving the area between 2025 and .
  • Net cross-border migration (between UK nations) led to a fall in the local population in South Lakeland of 295 people (−0.3%), as a result of 3,355 people entering the area and 3,650 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in South Lakeland's population of 583 (0.6%).as a result of 4,798 people entering the area and 4,216 people leaving the area between 2025 and 2028.
